comments.author: Ging
comments.body: Where to get this?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
You must:

1. Unlock and perform Nanban trade in Korea
2. Gather enough points from trading in Korea to unlock Busan as a Nanban port (40k)
3. Hope to be invited to visit Yi Sun-sin while trading in Busan (random event)

The Nanban item reward pool is somewhat large, so it can take a while to get this armor from him. Alternatively, buy it from other players. Cheers.

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: You can get this as a possible reward from Yi sun-sin after performing nanban trade in Busan. Be aware that it can take many MANY nanban trades as there's only a small chance your summoned by him (10-20% chance per trade) plus theres several other rewards you can get instead of the outfit. Good luck with it.
